segments.mn57:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koliyesu viharati haliddavasanaṃ nāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.
segments.mn57:2.1: Atha kho puṇṇo ca koliyaputto govatiko acelo ca seniyo kukkuravatiko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Acelo pana seniyo kukkuravatiko bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā kukkurova palikujjitvā [palikuṇṭhitvā (syā. kaṃ.), paliguṇṭhitvā (ka.)] ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
segments.mn57:2.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn57:2.3: “ayaṃ, bhante, acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko dukkarakārako chamānikkhittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati.
segments.mn57:2.4: Tassa taṃ kukkuravataṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ.
segments.mn57:2.6: “Alaṃ, puṇṇa, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
segments.mn57:2.7: Dutiyampi kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko … pe … tatiyampi kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn57:2.9: “ayaṃ, bhante, acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko dukkarakārako chamānikkhittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati.
segments.mn57:2.10: Tassa taṃ kukkuravataṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ.
segments.mn57:2.12: “Addhā kho te ahaṃ, puṇṇa, na labhāmi.
segments.mn57:2.13: Alaṃ, puṇṇa, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti;
segments.mn57:3.1: Idha, puṇṇa, ekacco kukkuravataṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkurasīlaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkuracittaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkurākappaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ.
segments.mn57:3.2: So kukkuravataṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkurasīlaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkuracittaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, kukkurākappaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā kukkurānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn57:3.3: Sace kho panassa evaṃdiṭṭhi hoti – ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti, sāssa [sāyaṃ (ka.)] hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
segments.mn57:3.4: Micchādiṭṭhissa [micchādiṭṭhikassa (sī.)] kho ahaṃ, puṇṇa, dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi – nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā.
segments.mn57:3.5: Iti kho, puṇṇa, sampajjamānaṃ kukkuravataṃ kukkurānaṃ sahabyataṃ upaneti, vipajjamānaṃ nirayan”ti.
segments.mn57:4.1: Evaṃ vutte, acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko parodi, assūni pavattesi.
segments.mn57:4.2: Atha kho bhagavā puṇṇaṃ koliyaputtaṃ govatikaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn57:4.4: Alaṃ, puṇṇa, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
segments.mn57:4.5: “Nāhaṃ, bhante, etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha;
segments.mn57:4.6: api ca me idaṃ, bhante, kukkuravataṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ.
segments.mn57:4.8: Tassa taṃ govataṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ.
segments.mn57:4.10: “Alaṃ, seniya, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
segments.mn57:4.11: Dutiyampi kho acelo seniyo … pe … tatiyampi kho acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn57:4.14: Tassa taṃ govataṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ.
segments.mn57:4.16: “Addhā kho te ahaṃ, seniya, na labhāmi.
segments.mn57:4.17: Alaṃ, seniya, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti;
segments.mn57:5.1: Idha, seniya, ekacco govataṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gosīlaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gocittaṃ bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gavākappaṃ [gvākappaṃ (ka.)] bhāveti paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ.
segments.mn57:5.2: So govataṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gosīlaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gocittaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ, gavākappaṃ bhāvetvā paripuṇṇaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā gunnaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn57:5.3: Sace kho panassa evaṃdiṭṭhi hoti – ‘imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti, sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
segments.mn57:5.4: Micchādiṭṭhissa kho ahaṃ, seniya, dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi – nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā.
segments.mn57:5.5: Iti kho, seniya, sampajjamānaṃ govataṃ gunnaṃ sahabyataṃ upaneti, vipajjamānaṃ nirayan”ti.
segments.mn57:6.1: Evaṃ vutte, puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko parodi, assūni pavattesi.
segments.mn57:6.2: Atha kho bhagavā acelaṃ seniyaṃ kukkuravatikaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn57:6.4: Alaṃ, seniya, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
segments.mn57:6.5: “Nāhaṃ, bhante, etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha;
segments.mn57:6.6: api ca me idaṃ, bhante, govataṃ dīgharattaṃ samattaṃ samādinnaṃ.
segments.mn57:6.8: pahoti bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathā ahaṃ cevimaṃ govataṃ pajaheyyaṃ, ayañceva acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko taṃ kukkuravataṃ pajaheyyā”ti.
segments.mn57:6.9: “Tena hi, puṇṇa, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn57:6.10: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.mn57:7.1: “Cattārimāni, puṇṇa, kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni.
segments.mn57:7.6: atthi, puṇṇa, kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ, kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
segments.mn57:8.2: Idha, puṇṇa, ekacco sabyābajjhaṃ [sabyāpajjhaṃ (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
segments.mn57:8.3: So sabyābajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn57:8.4: Tamenaṃ sabyābajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyābajjhā phassā phusanti.
segments.mn57:8.5: So sabyābajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyābajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti ekantadukkhaṃ, seyyathāpi sattā nerayikā.
segments.mn57:8.6: Iti kho, puṇṇa, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti;
segments.mn57:8.7: yaṃ karoti tena upapajjati, upapannamenaṃ phassā phusanti.
segments.mn57:8.10: Idaṃ vuccati, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
segments.mn57:9.2: Idha, puṇṇa, ekacco abyābajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, abyābajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, abyābajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
segments.mn57:9.3: So abyābajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā, abyābajjhaṃ vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā, abyābajjhaṃ manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā abyābajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn57:9.4: Tamenaṃ abyābajjhaṃ lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ abyābajjhā phassā phusanti.
segments.mn57:9.5: So abyābajjhehi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno abyābajjhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti ekantasukhaṃ, seyyathāpi devā subhakiṇhā.
segments.mn57:9.6: Iti kho, puṇṇa, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti;
segments.mn57:9.7: yaṃ karoti tena upapajjati, upapannamenaṃ phassā phusanti.
segments.mn57:9.10: Idaṃ vuccati, puṇṇa, kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ.
segments.mn57:10.2: Idha, puṇṇa, ekacco sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti.
segments.mn57:10.3: So sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi vacīsaṅkhāraṃ abhiṅkharitvā, sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi manosaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi lokaṃ upapajjati.
segments.mn57:10.4: Tamenaṃ sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi lokaṃ upapannaṃ samānaṃ sabyābajjhāpi abyābajjhāpi phassā phusanti.
segments.mn57:10.5: So sabyābajjhehipi abyābajjhehipi phassehi phuṭṭho samāno sabyābajjhampi abyābajjhampi vedanaṃ vedeti vokiṇṇasukhadukkhaṃ, seyyathāpi manussā ekacce ca devā ekacce ca vinipātikā.
segments.mn57:10.6: Iti kho, puṇṇa, bhūtā bhūtassa upapatti hoti;
segments.mn57:10.10: Idaṃ vuccati, puṇṇa, kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ.
segments.mn57:11.1: “Katamañca, puṇṇa, kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ, kammakkhayāya saṃvattati?
segments.mn57:11.2: Tatra, puṇṇa, yamidaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā, yamidaṃ [yampidaṃ (sī. pī.)] kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā, yamidaṃ [yampidaṃ (sī. pī.)] kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ tassa pahānāya yā cetanā – idaṃ vuccati, puṇṇa, kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ, kammakkhayāya saṃvattatīti.
segments.mn57:11.4: Imāni kho, puṇṇa, cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānī”ti.
segments.mn57:12.1: Evaṃ vutte, puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn57:12.3: Seyyathāpi, bhante … pe … upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.
segments.mn57:13.1: Acelo pana seniyo kukkuravatiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn57:13.4: Esāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
segments.mn57:13.5: Labheyyāhaṃ, bhante, bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan”ti.
segments.mn57:14.1: “Yo kho, seniya, aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ so cattāro māse parivasati. Catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti, upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya.
segments.mn57:14.3: “Sace, bhante, aññatitthiyapubbā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ te cattāro māse parivasanti catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya, ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi. Catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājentu, upasampādentu bhikkhubhāvāyā”ti.
segments.mn57:15.1: Alattha kho acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
segments.mn57:15.2: Acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā seniyo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva – yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ – brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
segments.mn57:15.3: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsi.
segments.mn57:15.4: Aññataro kho panāyasmā seniyo arahataṃ ahosīti.

lines: So hi ekopi kolanagare patiṭṭhitānaṃ koliyānaṃ rājakumārānaṃ nivāsaṭṭhānattā evaṃ vuccati.
Haliddavasananti tassa kira nigamassa māpitakāle pītakavatthanivatthā manussā nakkhattaṃ kīḷiṃsu.
Te nakkhattakīḷāvasāne nigamassa nāmaṃ āropentā haliddavasananti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.
Vihāro panettha kiñcāpi na niyāmito, tathāpi buddhānaṃ anucchavike senāsaneyeva vihāsīti veditabbo.
Govatikoti samādinnagovato, sīse siṅgāni ṭhapetvā naṅguṭṭhaṃ bandhitvā gāvīhi saddhiṃ tiṇāni khādanto viya carati.

Kukkurova palikujjitvāti sunakho nāma sāmikassa santike nisīdanto dvīhi pādehi bhūmiyaṃ vilekhitvā kukkurakūjitaṃ kūjanto nisīdati, ayampi “kukkurakiriyaṃ karissāmī”ti bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammoditvā dvīhi hatthehi bhūmiyaṃ vilekhitvā sīsaṃ vidhunanto ‘bhū bhū’ti katvā hatthapāde samiñjitvā sunakho viya nisīdi.
Kukkuracittanti “ajja paṭṭhāya kukkurehi kātabbaṃ karissāmī”ti evaṃ uppannacittaṃ.

Kukkurākappanti kukkurānaṃ gamanākāro atthi, tiṭṭhanākāro atthi, nisīdanākāro atthi, sayanākāro atthi, uccārapassāvakaraṇākāro atthi, aññe kukkure disvā dante vivaritvā gamanākāro atthi, ayaṃ kukkurākappo nāma, taṃ bhāvetīti attho.
Imināhaṃ sīlenātiādīsu ahaṃ iminā ācārena vā vatasamādānena vā dukkaratapacaraṇena vā methunaviratibrahmacariyena vāti attho.
Micchādiṭṭhīti adevalokagāmimaggameva devalokagāmimaggoti gahetvā uppannatāya sā assa micchādiṭṭhi nāma hoti.
Aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmīti tassa hi nirayato vā tiracchānayonito vā aññā gati natthi, tasmā evamāha.

words: nāhaṃ  bhante  etaṃ rodāmi  yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāhā
lines: Nāhaṃ, bhante, etaṃ rodāmi, yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāhāti yaṃ maṃ, bhante, bhagavā evamāha, ahametaṃ bhagavato byākaraṇaṃ na rodāmi na paridevāmi, na anutthunāmīti attho.
Evaṃ sakammakavasenettha attho veditabbo, na assumuñcanamattena.
“Mataṃ vā amma rodanti, yo vā jīvaṃ na dissati;
Jīvantaṃ amma passantī, kasmā maṃ amma rodasī”ti.(saṃ. ni.1.239)–
Apica me idaṃ, bhanteti apica kho me idaṃ, bhante, kukkuravataṃ dīgharattaṃ samādinnaṃ, tasmiṃ sampajjantepi vuddhi natthi, vipajjantepi.
Iti “ettakaṃ kālaṃ mayā katakammaṃ moghaṃ jātan”ti attano vipattiṃ paccavekkhamāno rodāmi, bhanteti.
Yathā pana tattha aññe kukkure disvā dante vivaritvā gamanākāro, evamidha aññe gāvo disvā kaṇṇe ukkhipitvā gamanākāro veditabbo.
Cattārimāni puṇṇa kammānīti kasmā imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhi?
Ayañhi desanā ekaccakammakiriyavasena āgatā, imasmiñca kammacatukke kathite imesaṃ kiriyā pākaṭā bhavissatīti imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhi.
Apica imaṃ kammacatukkameva desiyamānaṃ ime sañjānissanti, tato eko saraṇaṃ gamissati, eko pabbajitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇissatīti ayameva etesaṃ sappāyāti ñatvāpi imaṃ desanaṃ ārabhi.
Missakakammañhi katvā akusalena tiracchānayoniyaṃ maṅgalahatthiṭṭhānādīsu uppanno kusalena pavatte sukhaṃ vediyati.
Kusalena rājakulepi nibbatto akusalena pavatte dukkhaṃ vediyati.
Tañhi yadi kaṇhaṃ bhaveyya, kaṇhavipākaṃ dadeyya.
Ubhayavipākassa pana adānato akaṇhāsukkavipākattā “akaṇhaṃ asukkan”ti vuttaṃ.
Kāyasaṅkhārādīsu kāyadvāre gahaṇādivasena copanappattā dvādasa akusalacetanā sabyābajjhakāyasaṅkhāro nāma.
Vacīdvāre hanusañcopanavasena vacībhedapavattikā tāyeva dvādasa vacīsaṅkhāro nāma.
Ubhayacopanaṃ appattā raho cintayantassa manodvāre pavattā manosaṅkhāro nāma.
Iti tīsupi dvāresu kāyaduccaritādibhedā akusalacetanāva saṅkhārāti veditabbā.
Imasmiñhi sutte cetanā dhuraṃ, upālisutte kammaṃ.
Bhūtāti hetvatthe nissakkavacanaṃ, bhūtakammato bhūtassa sattassa uppatti hoti.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yathābhūtaṃ kammaṃ sattā karonti, tathābhūtena kammena kammasabhāgavasena tesaṃ upapatti hoti.
Ettha ca tenāti kammena viya vuttā, upapatti ca nāma vipākena hoti.
Yasmā pana vipākassa kammaṃ hetu, tasmā tena mūlahetubhūtena kammena nibbattatīti ayamettha attho.
Phassā phusantīti yena kammavipākena nibbatto, taṃkammavipākaphassā phusanti.
Kammadāyādāti kammadāyajjā kammameva nesaṃ dāyajjaṃ santakanti vadāmi.
Imasmiṃ vāre kāyadvāre pavattā aṭṭha kāmāvacarakusalacetanā kāyasaṅkhāro nāma.
Manodvāre pavattā tāyeva aṭṭha, tisso ca heṭṭhimajhānacetanā abyābajjhamanosaṅkhāro nāma.
Jhānacetanā tāva hotu, kāmāvacarā kinti abyābajjhamanosaṅkhāro nāma jātāti.
Kāmāvacaracetanā paṭhamajjhānacetanāya ghaṭitā, catutthajjhānacetanā tatiyajjhānacetanāya ghaṭitā.
Iti tīsupi dvāresu kāyasucaritādibhedā kusalacetanāva saṅkhārāti veditabbo.
Seyyathāpi manussātiādīsu manussānaṃ tāva kālena sukhaṃ kālena dukkhaṃ pākaṭameva, devesu pana bhummadevatānaṃ, vinipātikesu vemānikapetānaṃ kālena sukhaṃ kālena dukkhaṃ hotīti veditabbaṃ.
Tassa pahānāya yā cetanāti tassa pahānatthāya maggacetanā.
Kammaṃ patvāva maggacetanāya añño paṇḍarataro dhammo nāma natthi.
Idaṃ pana kammacatukkaṃ patvā dvādasa akusalacetanā kaṇhā nāma, tebhūmakakusalacetanā sukkā nāma, maggacetanā akaṇhā asukkāti āgatā.

“Labheyyāhaṃ, bhante”ti idaṃ so “ciraṃ vata me aniyyānikapakkhe yojetvā attā kilamito,‘sukkhanadītīre nhāyissāmī’ti samparivattentena viya thuse koṭṭentena viya ca na koci attho nipphādito, handāhaṃ attānaṃ yoge yojemī”ti cintetvā āha.
Atha bhagavā yonena khandhake titthiyaparivāso paññatto, yaṃ aññatitthiyapubbo sāmaṇerabhūmiyaṃ ṭhito –

“ahaṃ, bhante, itthannāmo aññatitthiyapubbo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye ākaṅkhāmi upasampadaṃ, svāhaṃ, bhante, saṅghaṃ cattāro māse parivāsaṃ yācāmī”tiādinā (mahāva.86) nayena samādiyitvā parivasati, taṃ sandhāya “yo kho, seniya, aññatitthiyapubbo”tiādimāha.
Upasampadatthikena pana nātikālena gāmappavesanādīni aṭṭha vattāni pūrentena parivasitabbaṃ.
Vitthārato panesa titthiyaparivāso samantapāsādikāya vinayaṭṭhakathāya pabbajjakhandhakavaṇṇanāyaṃ (mahāva. aṭṭha.86) vuttanayeneva veditabbo.
Ayaṃ puggalo parivāsāraho, ayaṃ na parivāsārahoti idaṃ mayhaṃ pākaṭanti dasseti.
“aho acchariyaṃ buddhasāsanaṃ, yattha evaṃ ghaṃsitvā koṭṭetvā yuttameva gaṇhanti, ayuttaṃ chaḍḍentī”ti.
Atha bhagavā tassa tibbacchandataṃ viditvā na seniyo parivāsaṃ arahatīti aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi –
“gaccha tvaṃ, bhikkhu, seniyaṃ nhāpetvā pabbājetvā ānehī”ti.
So tathā katvā taṃ pabbājetvā bhagavato santikaṃ ānayi.
“alattha kho acelo seniyo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadan”ti.
Vūpakaṭṭhoti vatthukāmakilesakāmehi kāyena ca cittena ca vūpakaṭṭho.
Pahitattoti kāye ca jīvite ca anapekkhatāya pesitatto vissaṭṭhaattabhāvo.
Sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvāti attanāyeva paññāya paccakkhaṃ katvā, aparappaccayaṃ ñatvāti attho.
Evamassa paccavekkhaṇabhūmiṃ dassetvā arahattanikūṭeneva desanaṃ niṭṭhāpetuṃ “aññataro kho panāyasmā seniyo arahataṃ ahosī”ti vuttaṃ.
Arahatanti arahantānaṃ, bhagavato sāvakānaṃ arahantānaṃ abbhantaro ahosīti ayamevattha adhippāyo.
Evaṃnāmake janapadeti atthavacanaṃ kasmā vuttanti āha “so hī”tiādi.
Na niyamitoti “asukamhi nāma vihāre”ti na niyametvā vutto.
Vesakiriyā ghāsaggahaṇādinā samādātabbaṭṭhena govataṃ, tasmiṃ niyutto govatiko.
“gacchaṃ bhakkheti, tiṭṭhaṃ mutteti, upāhā udakaṃ dhūpeti, tiṇāni chindatī”tiādi.
Ayaṃ aceloti acelakapabbajjāvasena acelo, purimo pana govatiko kukkuravatikoti ettha vuttanayānusārena attho vattabbo.
Palikuṇṭhitvāti ubho hatthe ubho pāde ca samiñjitvā.
Assa kukkuravatikassa aññā gati natthīti itaragatiṃ paṭikkhipati, itarāsaṃ pana sambhavo eva natthīti.

Yathā sakammakadhātusaddā atthavisesavasena akammakā honti “vibuddho puriso vibuddho kamalasaṇḍo”ti, evaṃ atthavisesavasena akammakāpi sakammakā hontīti dassento “na paridevāmi na anutthunāmī”tiādimāha.
Ayañcettha payogoti iminā gāthāyañca anutthunanarodanaṃ adhippetanti dasseti.
Gocittanti “ajja paṭṭhāya gohi kātabbaṃ karissāmī”ti uppannacittanti imamatthaṃ atidisati.
Gvākappe pana vattabbaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ “kukkurākappe vuttasadisamevā”ti imināva atidiṭṭhaṃ, visiṭṭhañca yathā pana tatthātiādinā vuttameva.
Yaṃ panettha vattabbaṃ, taṃ kukkuravatādīsu vuttanayameva.
Pākaṭā bhavissatīti “imasmiṃ kammacatukke idaṃ nāma kammaṃ bhajatī”ti pākaṭā bhavissati.
Kāḷakanti (a. ni. ṭī.2.4.232) malīnaṃ, cittassa apabhassarabhāvakaraṇanti attho.
Apāyūpapatti manussesu ca dobhaggiyaṃ kaṇhavipāko, yathā tamabhāvo vutto, ekattaniddesena pana “apāye nibbattanato”ti vuttaṃ, nibbattāpanatoti attho.
Sukkanti odātaṃ, cittassa pabhassarabhāvakaraṇanti attho, sukkābhijātihetuto vā sukkaṃ.

Saggūpapatti manussaloke sobhaggiyañca sukkavipāko, yathā ca jotibhāvo vutto, ekattaniddesena pana “sagge nibbattanato”ti vuttaṃ, nibbattāpanatoti attho, vomissakakammanti kālena kaṇhaṃ, kālena sukkanti evaṃ missakavasena katakammaṃ.
Kammassa kaṇhasukkasamaññā kaṇhasukkābhijātihetutāyāti, apaccayagāmitāya tadubhayavinimuttassa kammakkhayakarakammassa idha sukkapariyāyopi na icchitoti āha –
Sampattibhavapariyāpanno hi vipāko idha “sukkavipāko”ti adhippeto, na accantaparisuddho.
Sadukkhanti attanā uppādetabbena dukkhena sadukkhaṃ, dukkhasaṃvattanikanti attho.
“Imasmiṃ sutte cetanā dhuraṃ, upālisutte (ma. ni.2.56) kamman”ti heṭṭhā vuttampi atthaṃ idha sādhayati vijānanatthaṃ.
Taṃ pana paccayasamavāyasiddhito saṃkaḍḍhanaṃ piṇḍanaṃ viya hotīti āha –
Kammena viya vuttāti yaṃ karoti, tena upapajjatīti ekakammeneva jāyamānā viya vuttā apadādibhedā.
Upapatti ca nāma vipākena hoti vipāke sambhavante ekaṃsena te upapattivisesā sambhavanti.
Yadi evaṃ kasmā “tena upapajjatī”ti upapattikammahetukā vuttāti āha “yasmā panā”tiādi.
Yena kammavipākena nibbattoti yena kammavipākena vipaccamānena ayaṃ satto nibbattoti vuccati.
Kammena dātabbaṃ dāyaṃ tabbipākaṃ ādiyantīti kammadāyādā, phassā.
Kammassa dāyajjatā kammaphalassa dāyajjaṃ, tasmā vuttaṃ “kammadāyajjā”ti.
Tisso ca heṭṭhimajjhānacetanāti idaṃ abyābajjhavedanaṃ vediyanaekantasukhuppattiyā hetubhāvasādhanaṃ.
Yadi evaṃ yathāvuttā jhānacetanā tāva hotu ekantasukhuppattihetubhāvato.

Kāmāvacarā kintīti kāmāvacarā pana kusalacetanā taṃsabhāvābhāvato kinti kena pakārena abyābajjhamanosaṅkhāro nāma jātoti codeti, itaro pana na sabbā kāmāvacarakusalacetanā tathā gahitā, atha kho ekaccā jhānacetanānukūlāti dassento “kasiṇasajjanakāle kasiṇāsevanakāle labbhantī”ti āha.
Tattha kasiṇāsevanacetanā gahetabbā, sā upacārajjhānassa sādhikā.
Tena kāmāvacaracetanā paṭhamajjhānacetanāya ghaṭitāti kasiṇasajjanacetanāpi kadāci tādisā hotīti gahitā.
Parikammādivasena hi pavattā bhāvanāmayā kāmāvacarakusalacetanā paṭhamajjhānassa āsannatāya vuttā.
Catutthajjhānacetanā tatiyajjhānacetanāya ghaṭitāti idaṃ ekattakāyaekattasaññīsattāvāsavatāya taṃsarikkhakā upekkhāpi īdisesu ṭhānesu sukhasarikkhatā, evaṃ santasabhāvatā ñāṇasahitatā ca.

Keci pana catutthajjhānacetanānuguṇāti nidassentā kasiṇasajjanakāle kasiṇajjhānakāle kasiṇāsevanakāle labbhatīti tatiyajjhānacetanāya āsannaghaṭitatā vuttāti vadanti, taṃ tesaṃ matimattaṃ, vuttanayeneva tāsaṃ ghaṭitatā veditabbā.
Vemānikapetānanti idaṃ bāhullato vuttaṃ, itaresampi vinipātikānaṃ kālena dukkhaṃ hotiyeva.
Kammaṃ patvāti sukhakammanti vuccamāne maggacetanāya añño paṇḍarataro dhammo nāma natthi accantapārisuddhibhāvato.
Akaṇhā asukkāti āgatāti ettha sukkabhāvapaṭikkhepakāraṇaṃ heṭṭhā vuttanayameva.

Kāmaṃ tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ … pe … vihāsīti imināva arahattanikūṭena desanā niṭṭhāpitā hoti, āyasmato pana seniyassa paṭipattikittanaparametaṃ ujukaṃ āpannaarahattabhāvadīpanaṃ, yadidaṃ “aññataro kho panā”tiādivacananti āha “arahattanikūṭenevā”ti.
